senses.gloss: m. (תחח, transp. of חת; cmp. תותח, Job XLI, 21, = תחתח) crushing; עֲפַר ת׳ crushed, loose earth. Ohol. XVIII, 8 ועפר התי׳ (Mish. ed. והעפר, corr. acc., or והעָפָר התָּחוּחַ; Maim. comment. ed. Dehr. עֲפַר תּוֹחָח). Tosef. ib. XVI, 5 ואיזו היא בתולח … רושם ואין עפרח תי׳ ed. Zuck. (Var. ואין עפר תחתיו) virgin soil is that in which there is no imprint, and the earth of which is not ʿăfar tiḥuaḥ; Nidd. 8ᵇ, v. רְשָׁשִׁין.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 40a:3">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite> (Ms. F. <cite ref="V00183"><he>תוחח</he></cite>, v. supra). Y. B. Bath. II, beg. 13ᵇ <he>מפני שעושין עפר תח׳ וכ׳</he> because they (the rocks or boulders near a wall) make the ground around them loose, and affect the earth of the wall; Bab.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 19b:2">B. Bath. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>שמחלידין … ומעלין עפר תי׳</he> they (the roots of trees near a wall) undermine the ground, and generate loose earth; a. e.
